subject: Interview slate + debrief orchestration — role clarity & leveling
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate intro + proposed slate for Senior Inference Engineer (please align)

Camila —

Attaching Samira Kaur's resume and my recommended slate for the Senior Inference Engineer role (she's coming from an inference-focused infra team). Can you take a quick pass on role scope and leveling expectations so we can finalize interviewer assignments? Key facts:

- Candidate: Samira Kaur, 7+ years, recent role: Staff ML Infra Engineer at ScaleLabs
- Strengths highlighted: kernel-level optimization, quantization experiments, production KV cache strategies
- Unknowns: breadth of model compilation experience and rollout/rollback playbooks

Proposed interview slate (30–45m each):
1) System design + inference architecture (Vivek) — emphasis on end-to-end serving tradeoffs
2) Performance debugging & kernels (you / bar-raiser) — probe low-level optimizations and profiling experience
3) Prompting & evaluation considerations (Laura) — production evals, regression detection
4) Culture+collab & leadership (Camila) — cross-team work, prioritization, tradeoff framing

Attachments: Samira_Kaur_Resume.pdf, proposed_interview_slate.md

Ask: 1) Do these focus areas map to the role you want to hire for? 2) Any adjustments to leveling signals we should surface to interviewers (ex: independent kernel ownership vs. project leadership)? 3) Want a short take-home (2–3 hour) or prefer fully interview-based evaluation?

I can loop in Marissa as bar-raiser once you sign off. Also copying Laura (hiring partner) to coordinate debrief template.

Thanks —
Aditya
Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate intro + proposed slate for Senior Inference Engineer (please align)

Thanks — quick thoughts below. Long version attached as calibration_notes.docx.

Role scope (high level):
- We need someone who owns the serving runtime surface: compilation decisions, kernel tradeoffs, cache strategies, and operational SLOs. This is not primarily a model-research role; emphasis is product-facing infra for inference scale and cost.

Leveling signals to emphasize to interviewers:
- Senior (IC4): owns pieces end-to-end, can drive a cross-team performance improvement (measurable), solid debugging depth but not necessarily owning compilation stack.
- Staff (IC5): owns and designs kernel selection/compilation tradeoffs, has shipped cross-product rollout patterns, mentors others on performance culture.

Interview focus adjustments:
- Make the system-design story specifically about runtime decisions: batching, KV/prefix caching, graceful fallbacks, and multi-variant routing.
- Add a short troubleshooting exercise (15m live whiteboard) in the performance interview to see hands-on profiling reasoning — no take-home required for this role.
- Marissa should own bar-raiser questions around tradeoff reasoning and hiring bar continuity.

Interviewer assignments: Vivek — systems design; Marissa — performance/bar-raiser; Laura — eval & debrief; Camila — leadership & scope.

I attached calibration_notes.docx with a 3-level rubric and 2 anchor questions. Please update the slate and send candidate availability.

Camila Reyes
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate intro + proposed slate for Senior Inference Engineer (please align)

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 11:03 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I attached calibration_notes.docx with a 3-level rubric and 2 anchor questions. Please update the slate and send candidate availability.

Thanks for the context — I skimmed the resume and Camila's notes. A couple of practical anchor items I want interviewers to capture during debrief:

- Evidence of: shipped perf features with measurable metrics (throughput/token/sec, p50/p99 changes) and ability to reason about cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Depth vs. breadth signals: did candidate implement or own low-level kernels OR primarily run experiments?
- Safety/rollback thinking: did they design rollout/fallback policies when a new model variant regresses?

Two anchor questions to standardize across interviews (use exactly as written):
1) "Walk me through a time you reduced p99 latency in a production inference path. What was the source of the latency, what measurements did you collect, what tradeoffs did you consider, and what did you ship?"
2) "You deploy a quantized variant that improves cost by 30% but increases a specific output regression in edge prompts. How do you design a rollout with automated guardrails?"

Please add these to the proposed_interview_slate.md and ensure each interviewer has at least one of the anchor questions visible in their prompt. I'll join the debrief for final sign-off.

—Marissa
Bar-raiser, Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Scheduling: Senior Inference Engineer interviews (Samira Kaur)

- Tue Apr 13, 09:00–12:00

Calendar invites will follow once you confirm a day. Attached: Samira_Kaur_Resume.pdf (for reference).

Thanks team — a couple of admin notes before we loop Samira in:

- Debrief owners: Laura to capture evidence & scores in the template; interviewers to fill anchor-question notes inline.
- Passing criteria: at least 3 of 4 interviews green on core areas OR one outstanding domain (e.g., kernel design) + no critical red flags.
- Post-interview timeline: debrief within 24 hours, hiring manager decision within 48 hours of debrief.

I'll attach the debrief_template.md to the loop and will schedule a 30m final sync if the panel recommends moving forward. Everyone — please review the anchor questions from Marissa and add any last-minute edge probes in the shared slate.

Camila
